conversation_pain_points: bot deflected to doctor despite stated barrier

main_topics.reason: The user opened with it and every turn concerns explaining and lowering fasting readings of 160-180.
The user explicitly asked what they can do themselves and described walking and eating less rice.
Several turns covered when the user takes metformin, the dose, and whether it is XR.
The bot proposed a 3am reading and the user asked how it works, but the discussion was brief.
The bot raised add-on drugs and insulin, but the user wanted self-help rather than medication changes.
The user gave post-meal readings once as context showing only mornings are high.

output.summary: The user asked why their fasting blood sugar is always high despite taking metformin at night, and wanted things they could do themselves. The bot repeatedly suggested insulin after being told the user takes none, and kept pointing to the doctor and repeating light-dinner advice, so the user had to correct it. It ended with a suggested 3am glucose check and the user accepting with a terse thanks.
